verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's official, first-party application framework documented on svelte.dev. It provides file-based routing: pages are created by adding files to `src/routes`, with per-page rendering choices and page preloading. Community users confirm its route and load structure works well in practice, though one notes that folder-based layout and route hierarchy is a design gripe. missing for 10: detailed routing docs in evidence (dynamic params, layouts, programmatic navigation API), a standalone router option separate from the full SvelteKit meta-framework.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework

citations.quote: You create pages by adding files to the `src/routes` directory of your project.
SvelteKit allows for nicely mixing and matching different rendering types on different pages.
the new SvelteKit structure is a big improvement. It is now very clear in what order items load and what loads on the server vs the client.
